items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Yeah, I remember Bud just played bass years ago... Buddy told me he had joined church

ctx.x: What about old Bud Russo, remember him?

Yeah, I remember Bud just played bass years ago. Sure stuff But the birth of that was in 44. That's been a long time. I haven't seen the birth for a long while. But last time I see it, Buddy told me he had joined church and he was playing his bass in the church. He told me.
It was the time the war was going on. What about little dad? Remember little dad played banjo?
